reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis builds on known principles of preheating to reduce residual stresses in additive manufacturing and seems scientifically sound with minor open questions about the precise optimal temperature range and microstructural impacts.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison test with preheated vs. non-preheated builds, measuring residual stresses, microstructure, and mechanical properties, would decisively confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a key challenge (residual stress and segregation) in additively manufacturing AlCrFeNiSi and provides a straightforward processing adjustment that researchers can readily attempt.
